oracle.utils.add_wise_columns module

oracle.utils.add_wise_columns.get_wise_magnitudes(ra, dec, radius_arcsec=2.75, catalog='II/328/allwise')

Queries Vizier for WISE magnitudes (W1, W2, W3, W4) for a given RA and Dec.

Parameters: ra (float): Right Ascension in degrees. dec (float): Declination in degrees. radius_arcsec (float): Search radius in arcseconds. catalog (str): Vizier catalog ID. Default is AllWISE (II/328/allwise).

Returns: astropy.table.Table: A table containing the matched WISE sources and their magnitudes.
